description: Defines structures and a class for managing the PDCP transmission window, including SDU info, window elements, and interface methods for adding, removing, and querying SDUs within the transmission window.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_window
classes.description: Manages the transmission window for PDCP, providing methods to add, remove, and query SDUs and PDUs.

methods.name: has_sn
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number exists in the window.

methods.name: add_sdu
methods.description: Adds an SDU info to the transmission window.

methods.name: remove_sdu
methods.description: Removes an SDU from the transmission window based on sequence number.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a window element by sequence number.

methods.name: get_nof_sdus
methods.description: Returns the number of SDUs in the window.

methods.name: get_sdu_bytes
methods.description: Returns the total bytes of SDUs in the window.

methods.name: get_pdu_bytes
methods.description: Returns the total bytes of PDUs in the window, considering security integrity.
